source: Local exact supplier/creator/binding/save/reopen consumers and actual combined three-engine paper lifecycle; not production ERP access

stock.serials: 1..500 nonempty strings when supplied; order retained; no quantity inferred
stock.dates: real YYYY-MM-DD; no expiry status inferred

payroll.hours: independent exact decimal string, declared precision, uom=hour and provenance
payroll.hourlyRate: independent same-document-currency money and provenance; never multiplied
payroll.summary: supplied gross/deductions/netPay/employerContributions only; no hours/rate on summary

statement.dueDate: existing real source date; no aging/payment state inferred

validation: Both normalizeBusinessDocument and createBusinessDocumentProject reject unknown keys, invalid types/dates, missing provenance, currency/precision mismatch and over-500 lists; legacy inputs remain supported.

sourceBasis.fix: Capture initial canonical /printRows section/description/direction/trace as fixed-source bindings, not numeric tokens; reject rebinding/static/format/collection substitution, retain allowed structural removal and original contract across re-addition; labels/style remain editable.
sourceBasis.consumerProof: 43 industry cases plus7 existing binding-invariant cases passed after correcting the add_field section input and proving correct restoration.

verification.scope: Actual complete combined source tree including industry contracts, fixed-source guard, valid original-binding restoration and registered form-authoring evaluations; no fake model response or additional production qualification.

limits: No GS1 parsing/encoding or certification, statutory payroll/ERP completeness, calculation/FX/UOM conversion, stock posting, payment or real-data/model permission.
